blocks.orig: Along Zanzibar’s northeast coast, near Mnemba Island, many bottlenose and spinner dolphins can be found. Go on a boat trip to see these sleek, grey creatures jack-knife through the water, sometimes showing off with playful jumps and twists. Of course, this is nature, and we cannot guarantee you will actually see these beautiful swimmers – but chances are fairly high. We don’t promote swimming with them (to avoid disturbing them), but even without that, this boat trip is definitely one to enjoy!
blocks.html: Plenty of spinner and bottlenose dolphins live along the northeast coast of Zanzibar, close to Mnemba Island. Join a boat trip to watch these sleek grey animals slice through the water, at times showing off with playful leaps and spins. This is nature, of course, so we cannot promise that you will see these lovely swimmers – though the odds are fairly good. We don’t encourage swimming with them (so they are not disturbed), but even so, this boat trip is well worth enjoying!
